set.body: Acceptance criteria: pin redistributable or fetch-reproducible annotated recordings spanning static images, reading, dynamic video, pursuit, noise, blink, loss, dropout, and sampling degradation; report class-wise precision/recall/F1, onset and offset error, duration and count bias, centre error, peak-velocity error, and robustness curves by stimulus class; record dataset license/version, detector card/configuration, platform, and source revision in machine-readable release artifacts; distinguish missing benchmark coverage from passing validation; add deterministic smoke gates and non-vacuous failure fixtures without treating aggregate accuracy as sufficient.
set.title: Human-annotated detector benchmark and validation reports
